d:
The 76ers defeated the Pacers, 114-109 tonight in Indiana. Tyrese Maxey finished with a team-high 27 points along with 5 rebounds and 4 assists for the 76ers, while Joel Embiid tallied 21 points, 11 rebounds and 2 assists in the game. Pascal Siakam recorded 26 points, 11 rebounds and 3 assists. The 76ers improve their record to 4-1 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 2-3 for the season.
